first_principles.programs_as_data: For a fixed interpreter U, an executable procedure p can be encoded as data d such that U(d,x)=p(x). Therefore file type, storage location, serialization, or the label JIT knowledge cannot by themselves make capability non-capability.
first_principles.classification_rule: Classify a dependency by what information/function it causally supplies to task performance, not by how it is stored.

admissible_jit_knowledge_tests: The payload states extensional source-grounded facts, relations, measurements, definitions, or domain rules that are independently truth-assessable.
The payload does not encode a task policy, reusable search/control procedure, hidden target outputs, or a decoder whose purpose is to produce winning actions.
A fixed Brain-owned mechanism performs the reasoning, search, planning, selection, and verification using the payload.
Replacing the external source with another source expressing the same truths does not change the required Brain-owned procedure.
The payload can be provenance-bound to an authoritative or otherwise admissible source without relying on the donor as an opaque target-capability executor.
capability_bearing_signals: The same payload acts as a reusable policy or algorithm across multiple task instances.
The payload contains control flow, search heuristics, executable transformation rules, policy tables, answer maps, or target-output leakage.
Correctness of the payload can only be established by trusting the same opaque capability that generated it.
Removing the payload deletes procedural competence rather than only domain facts.
consequence: JIT semantic facts may substitute for stored model knowledge, but an external semantic parser, reasoning policy, or reusable decoder remains capability-bearing even if fetched as data.
hard_nonclaims: No claim every declarative rule set is automatically knowledge.
No claim every reusable fact is capability.
No terminal acceptance family capability or ownership credit.
